Later, 10 boys joined the club. What percent of the members now are girls?

# Response to the question

Originally, 60% of 40 members were girls: 0.60 × 40 = 24 girls. So boys originally = 40 − 24 = 16 boys. After 10 boys join, total members = 40 + 10 = 50 members. Girls remain 24. Percent of members who are girls = 24 ÷ 50 × 100 = 48%. Answer: 48%
